纳瓦特尔语.pinyin: wǒ zài xué xiào xué Nà wǎ tè ěr yǔ wǒ shì Mò xī gē rén
纳瓦特尔语.en: I learn Nahuatl at my school. I'm Mexican.
纳瓦特尔语.es: Aprendo el náhuatl en mi escuela. Soy mexicano.

美中不足.zh: 唯一美中不足的是如果它要是熟食就好了。
美中不足.pinyin: wéi yī měi zhōng bù zú de shì rú guǒ tā yào shi shú shí jiù hǎo le
美中不足.en: The only thing that would have made it better is if it was cooked.

美中不足.zh: 那家馆子物美价廉，美中不足的是他们糟糕的位置。
美中不足.pinyin: nà jiā guǎn zi wù měi jià lián měi zhōng bù zú de shì tā men zāo gāo de wèi zhi
美中不足.en: That place's food is great, and their prices are good, but the fly in the ointment is their terrible location.

聋哑人.pinyin: Tāng mǔ shì lóng yǎ rén

花展.zh: 我要把我的玫瑰拿到花展上展示。
花展.pinyin: wǒ yào bǎ wǒ de méi guī ná dào huā zhǎn shàng zhǎn shì
花展.en: I'm going to exhibit my roses at the flower show.

行行好.pinyin: xíng xing hǎo bié kū le
行行好.en: In the name of mercy, stop crying.

行行好.pinyin: gěi wǒ diǎn shuǐ ba xíng xing hǎo
行行好.en: Be so kind as to give me some water.

趁热.pinyin: chèn rè hē nǐ de tāng
趁热.en: Eat your soup while it is hot.
趁热.es: Cómete la sopa mientras esté caliente.

趁热.pinyin: ràng wǒ men chèn rè chī ba
趁热.en: Let's eat while the food is warm.

跑者.pinyin: wǒ shì zuì kuài de pǎo zhě

追溯.zh: 山上的老教堂的历史可以追溯到12世纪。
追溯.pinyin: shān shàng de lǎo jiào táng de lì shǐ kě yǐ zhuī sù dào shì jì
追溯.en: The old church on the hill dates back to the twelfth century.

追随.pinyin: zhuī suí nǐ de mèng xiǎng

追随.zh: 汤姆想追随他父亲的脚步。
追随.pinyin: Tāng mǔ xiǎng zhuī suí tā fù qīn de jiǎo bù
追随.en: Tom wanted to follow in his father's footsteps.
追随.es: Tom quería seguir los pasos de su padre.

遛.zh: 你可以骑上我的摩托车去遛一圈。
遛.pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ qí shàng wǒ de mó tuō chē qù liù yī quān
遛.en: You can have a ride on my motorcycle.
